items.notes: 特殊天幕。结局演出用；雾墙占据远层的整个上半，越往上越接近洋红天空的位置时直接截断。把图左右拼接两次检查首尾衔接；越远越冷越灰；天空必须是平涂洋红，天空渐变、日月与星空由渲染层画；不画人物与文字。

subject.zh: 雾墙前的近层：低低的白色雾带贴着海蓝的海面横向漂浮，雾中露出一座孤零零的石砌望雾塔剪影
subject.en: Near layer before the mist wall: low white mist drifting sideways just above the sea-blue water, the lone silhouette of a stone mist-watch tower showing through it

extra.zh: 这是特殊天幕的近层，叠在远层前面；画出的部分以外全部是洋红；左右两端首尾无缝衔接。
extra.en: This is the near layer of a special sky, laid in front of its far layer; magenta everywhere outside what is drawn; the left and right ends join seamlessly.

items.notes: 特殊天幕。结局演出用；雾墙占据远层的整个上半，越往上越接近洋红天空的位置时直接截断。把图左右拼接两次检查首尾衔接；越远越冷越灰；天空必须是平涂洋红，天空渐变、日月与星空由渲染层画；不画人物与文字。

subject.zh: 候见厅的判决之后：纯白大厅里，长桌后五位女神被白光勾勒出身影，正中白金长发、背后有几何光环的女神抬着手；桌前玩家脚下的白石地板化作一个门形的洞，没有底，玩家正向下坠落
subject.en: After the judgement in the antechamber: in a pure white hall five goddesses sit behind a long table outlined by white light, the one at the center with platinum hair and a geometric halo raising her hand; before the table the white floor under the player has become a bottomless door-shaped hole and the player is falling into it

extra.zh: 高俯视，长桌在画面上方三分之一，门形的洞在中下部，玩家只是一个正在下坠的剪影，衣角向上飘；洞里纯黑，光来自上方的白。
extra.en: High angle: the long table in the upper third, the door-shaped hole in the lower middle, the player only a falling silhouette with clothes fluttering upward; the hole is pure black, the light comes from the white above.

items.notes: 序章的高潮画面。女神们的脸可以很小，靠剪影与配色区分：光环、断角、硬币、花发、兜帽。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 兽潮之夜的午夜：边石镇北门外，一具由灰黑碎石与焦木堆成的巨像高过城墙，胸口嵌着一团暗紫发光的核，镇上的钟楼与木栅映着火光，守军举着火把与长枪，夜空无月
subject.en: Midnight of the night of the beast tide: outside the north gate of Edgestone a colossus heaped from gray-black rubble and charred timber towers over the wall, a dark purple glowing core lodged in its chest, the town bell tower and palisade lit by fire, defenders holding torches and spears, a moonless sky

extra.zh: 高机位远景，巨像在画面左上方压下来，木栅与守军在右下；火把的暖光与核的暗紫是仅有的两种光。
extra.en: High wide shot, the colossus looming down from the upper left, the palisade and defenders lower right; torch warmth and the dark purple of the core are the only two lights.

items.notes: 暗紫只用在巨像的核上。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 黎明前的一刀：边石镇一道栅门前，深红短发、系着围裙的高大女人双手握着一把宽刃长刀，刀光像一道白线横贯夜色，把扑来的灰黑潮水一刀斩断，照亮了半个镇子
subject.en: One stroke before dawn: before a palisade gate of Edgestone a tall woman with short crimson hair and an apron holds a broad-bladed long sword in both hands, its light a single white line across the night, cutting the onrushing gray-black tide in two and lighting up half the town

extra.zh: 高机位远景，刀光的白线斜贯画面中部，女人在线的左端是一个小小的剪影；被斩开的潮水在两侧翻起；远处屋顶上有几个看呆的人影。
extra.en: High wide shot, the white line of the stroke slanting across the middle, the woman a small silhouette at its left end; the split tide rearing on both sides; a few stunned figures on distant rooftops.

items.notes: 看见的人很多、看清的人很少：人物要小，刀光要大。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 梦中的门口：像夜里关了灯的房间那样的黑，前方一扇门开着一条缝，暖色的光从缝里漏出来，门口站着一个女人，脸有一半在阴影里，腰间挂满一动不动的钥匙
subject.en: The doorway in the dream: darkness like a room at night with the lights off, ahead a door open a crack with warm light spilling out, a woman standing in the doorway with half her face in shadow and many keys hanging motionless at her waist

extra.zh: 标准机位中景，门在画面正中偏右，女人站在门口的光里，只看得清下半张脸与钥匙；其余全是暗。
extra.en: Standard angle medium shot, the door just right of center, the woman standing in its light, only the lower half of her face and the keys clearly visible; everything else dark.

items.notes: 她只能叫门口的女人：不画任何可以辨认的名字或标记。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 门后的小院：门被推开，门后是一个小小的院子，一间木头小屋、一小片翻过土的园子和一棵树，晨光柔和，一切都很小却很安静，院子正中空着一块地
subject.en: The little yard behind the door: the door swings open on a small yard, a wooden cottage, a small patch of turned soil and a single tree, soft morning light, everything small but very quiet, a clear spot left empty in the middle of the yard

extra.zh: 标准机位全景，从门框里看进去，门框的暗边框住画面；院子正中留一块空地，给叠层画上的第一件物品。
extra.en: Standard angle full shot looking in through the doorframe, whose dark edges frame the picture; an empty spot in the middle of the yard for the first object, which is drawn as an overlay.

items.notes: 第一件物品有十种，用叠层另画，这张不画。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 伯爵来信：清晨的边石镇南门驿站，驿卒刚下马，马鼻喷着白气，独臂的老登记员站在驿站门口拿着一封带暗红火漆的信，门外的南大路穿过麦田缓坡伸向远方的地平线
subject.en: The count letter: early morning at the Edgestone south gate post station, a courier just dismounted with his horse breathing white, the one-armed old registrar standing in the station door holding a letter sealed in dark red wax, the south road running out through the sloping wheat fields to the far horizon

extra.zh: 高机位，人物在画面下方三分之一，南大路占据画面纵深，远处地平线上是淡淡的城影：第一幕最后的拉远。
extra.en: High angle, the figures in the lower third, the south road carrying the eye into depth, a faint city outline on the far horizon: the final pull-back of the first act.

items.notes: 信纸上不画任何字。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 城下潮：夜里俯瞰瓦伦堡下城与河港，泥巷井口、鱼市排水口与河港闸门同时喷出灰黑潮水般的魔物，街道上火把与盾阵排开，仓库与吊车映着火光，上城钟楼亮着警火
subject.en: The Undertide: a night view down over the lower town and river harbor of Valenburg, a well head in the Mud Lane, the fish market drain and the harbor sluice all spewing a gray-black tide of monsters at once, torches and shield lines across the streets, warehouses and cranes lit by fire, alarm fires on the bell tower of the upper town

extra.zh: 顶视偏高的俯瞰，三个喷口在画面里呈三角分布，盾阵在它们之间；河在画面下缘。
extra.en: A near-overhead view, the three outlets forming a triangle, the shield lines between them; the river along the bottom edge.

items.notes: 第二幕高潮；魔物只画成潮水般的灰黑群体，不画细节。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 黄昏的星笔塔观星台：黄铜支架托着一块水晶的检索仪立在台中央，水晶里一片暗，穿深蓝长袍、戴细框眼镜的贤者背对画面站在仪器前，城下潮的烟还没散尽，远处有人在修钟楼
subject.en: The Stylus Tower observatory at dusk: a search device of a crystal held in a brass stand at the center of the platform, the crystal dark, a sage in a deep blue robe and thin-framed glasses standing before it with his back to us, smoke from the Undertide still hanging over the city, someone repairing a bell tower in the distance

extra.zh: 标准机位中景，仪器在画面中央，贤者在左，城市的黄昏在右后方；水晶是画面里唯一的冷色。
extra.en: Standard angle medium shot, the device at center, the sage at left, the city at dusk behind on the right; the crystal is the only cool color.

items.notes: 水晶里不画字。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 鹰丘大厅的清晨：高大的石厅里阳光从高窗斜射进来，王都使者站在台阶上展开文书，厅两侧站着贵族与军官，有人掩口而笑，台阶下站着受封者的背影
subject.en: Morning in the Hawkhill hall: sunlight slanting through high windows into a tall stone hall, the royal envoy on the steps unrolling a document, nobles and officers along both sides, someone hiding a laugh behind a hand, the back of the one being ennobled at the foot of the steps

extra.zh: 标准机位全景，对称构图，使者在台阶顶端，受封者背影在画面下方正中。
extra.en: Standard angle full shot, symmetrical, the envoy at the top of the steps, the back of the honoree at the bottom center.

items.notes: 文书上不画字；受封者是玩家，只画背影。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 灰烬防线：早春融雪的灰溪上一座石桥，西南岸是圣战军的白色旗海与投石机，东岸桥头是灰烬民兵的盾墙与木栅，桥头上空一道白金光柱正在落下，东北丘陵上站着一排魔族剪影
subject.en: The Ash Line: a stone bridge over the meltwater-swollen Greybrook in early spring, a sea of white crusade banners and catapults on the southwest bank, the shield wall and palisade of the ash militia at the east bridgehead, a white-gold pillar of light descending over the bridge, a row of demonkin silhouettes on the northeast hills

extra.zh: 高机位远景，石桥斜贯画面中央，光柱从画面上方落向桥头；两军在两岸，丘陵在右上。
extra.en: High wide shot, the bridge slanting across the center, the pillar of light falling from the top onto the bridgehead; the armies on both banks, the hills upper right.

items.notes: 光柱是神光白金，是这张图的主光；旗帜只画几何纹章。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 决战第二日的黄昏之后：光柱刚熄，大主教跪倒在桥头，眼白里浮着白金色的光，他地上的影子转成一圈圈精密的几何纹样，像缓慢转动的齿轮，士兵们后退，远处丘顶一个深红短发的女将仰天大笑
subject.en: After dusk on the second day of battle: the pillar of light just gone out, the archbishop on his knees at the bridgehead with platinum light in the whites of his eyes, his shadow on the ground turned into rings of precise geometric patterns like slowly turning gears, soldiers backing away, a crimson-haired woman general laughing at the sky on a distant hilltop

extra.zh: 低机位中景，大主教在画面中央，几何纹样的影子铺满前景地面；远处丘顶的女将是右上角的小剪影。
extra.en: Low angle medium shot, the archbishop at center, the geometric shadow spread across the foreground ground; the general a small silhouette at upper right.

items.notes: 只画影子的形状，不画光的主人。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 大陆展开：镜头从荒原南沿的封门遗迹升起，遗迹越来越小，大地向四面铺开，西边是河谷王国，东边是平原上的帝国，南方海岸，东方的森林与草原，北方冒烟的高地，最远处一圈灰白终雾
subject.en: The continent unfolds: the view rises from the sealed ruins on the southern edge of the waste, the ruins shrinking as the land spreads in every direction, the river kingdom to the west, the empire on its plains to the east, the southern coast, the forests and steppes of the east, the smoking highlands of the north, and farthest of all a ring of gray-white mist

extra.zh: 顶视的极远景，像从高空看一张立体的地形沙盘；遗迹在画面中下部，终雾在四边。
extra.en: An overhead extreme wide shot like looking down on a relief model of the land; the ruins in the lower middle, the mist around all four edges.

items.notes: 不画任何边界线与地名，那是界面的事。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 眠鳞会盟：触穹峰顶，七座古老的高背石座排成半环围着一块高耸的天启碑，各国代表坐在石座前，其中一座石座空着，云海在脚下翻涌，碑面泛着微光
subject.en: The Sleepscale conclave: on the summit of Vaulttouch seven ancient high-backed stone seats stand in a half ring around a towering revelation stele, envoys of the nations seated before them, one seat empty, a sea of cloud surging below, a faint glow on the stele face

extra.zh: 高机位全景，碑在画面上方正中，半环的石座朝向镜头展开，空着的那一座要醒目。
extra.en: High full shot, the stele at top center, the half ring of seats opening toward the viewer, the empty seat clearly noticeable.

items.notes: 碑面只有光，不画字。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 天启：会盟表决的那一刻，七席石中央的天启碑亮起一种从没见过的白，白光直冲天空，石座前的代表纷纷起身抬头，远处云海里另有六道光柱同时升起
subject.en: The revelation: at the moment of the vote the stele at the center of the Seven Seats lights up with a white no one has ever seen, the light shooting into the sky, the envoys rising from their seats and looking up, six more pillars of light rising at once far away across the sea of cloud

extra.zh: 低机位远景，碑的白光是画面中心，六道远处的光柱沿地平线分布。
extra.en: Low wide shot, the white light of the stele at the center, six distant pillars spread along the horizon.

items.notes: 碑面显出的字由界面以字幕给出，图上不画字。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 众门环：主门坑坑沿的环形石台上立着一圈门框，一道道细细的金线从这里向远方的地平线延伸，执钥人们各守一处门框，坑底是漆黑的湖，灰云低垂
subject.en: The ring of gates: on a ring platform at the rim of the main crater a circle of doorframes stands, thin gold lines running from it toward the far horizon, keybearers guarding each frame, a pitch-black lake at the bottom of the crater, low gray clouds

extra.zh: 高机位远景，环台在画面中部，金线向画面四边放射。
extra.en: High wide shot, the ring platform in the middle, gold lines radiating toward the edges.

items.notes: 门扉金只在门框与金线上。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 灰烬决战：主门坑上空灰云翻涌，坑底断成两截的巨门框旁，一个巨大的无脸人形站在湖心石台上，脸是一片光滑的空白，身后是倒置扭曲的层层黑紫门扉，坑沿上联军的旗帜与兵团一线排开
subject.en: The Ashen final battle: gray clouds churning over the main crater, beside the colossal broken doorframe at the bottom a huge faceless figure stands on a stone island in the lake, its face a smooth blank plane, layers of inverted, twisted black-purple doors behind it, the banners and legions of the alliance ranged along the rim

extra.zh: 低机位远景，巨大人形在画面中央偏上，联军在前景下缘只是一排小剪影。
extra.en: Low wide shot, the huge figure just above center, the alliance only a row of small silhouettes along the bottom edge.

items.notes: 澱紫只用在人形与门扉上。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 接住：主门坑的裂缝里伸出一只手，手腕上挂满钥匙，抓住了正在坠落的人；裂缝边显出一个女人的半身，她半边身体是一道门框，脸一半在阴影里、一半在灰光里
subject.en: Caught: a hand reaches out of the rift in the main crater, its wrist hung with keys, catching a falling figure; at the edge of the rift half the body of a woman appears, one half of her body a doorframe, her face half in shadow and half in the gray light

extra.zh: 标准机位近景，手与被抓住的手腕在画面中央，女人在右侧；背景是灰光与裂缝的黑。
extra.en: Standard angle close shot, the catching hand and the caught wrist at center, the woman on the right; behind, gray light and the black of the rift.

items.notes: 她只能叫门口的女人。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 审期至：主门坑上空的灰散开，远处七道光柱同时升起，敞开的封门里透出向上的光，门边站着一具披灰白长袍、眼窝里两点冷蓝火光的骸骨，一个发梢化作羽毛的黑发少女站在门前回头
subject.en: The time of judgement: the ash over the main crater parts, seven pillars of light rising at once far away, light streaming upward from the open sealed door, beside it a skeleton in a gray-white robe with two cold blue flames in its eye sockets, a black-haired girl whose hair ends turn to feathers standing at the door looking back

extra.zh: 低机位全景，门在画面正中，光从门里向上；骸骨在左，少女在门前右侧。
extra.en: Low full shot, the door at center with light pouring up out of it; the skeleton at left, the girl at right before the door.

items.notes: 天上显出的字由界面以字幕给出，图上只画光。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 共读：纯白审庭中央的庭镜像一汪平静的水，镜面里映出一只巨大的手慢慢松开、把一座小小的庭园放下；庭镜旁，兜帽书记官与一个脸半在阴影里的女人一同低头读着一张摊开的古卷
subject.en: The joint reading: at the center of the pure white court the court mirror lies like still water, reflecting a vast hand slowly opening and setting a tiny garden down; beside the mirror a hooded scribe and a woman with half her face in shadow bend together over an unrolled ancient scroll

extra.zh: 高机位全景，庭镜占画面中央的一大块，两人在镜旁左下。
extra.en: High full shot, the mirror filling a large central area, the two figures beside it at lower left.

items.notes: 古卷上不画可读的字，只有墨色的块。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 庭镜旁的门：审庭里一扇门打开，门外是无边的暗，暗中远远悬着一个蓝白色的球形世界，四周没有雾墙，星辰不整齐地散在四面八方，五位女神与玩家站在门前望着它
subject.en: The door beside the mirror: a door opens in the court onto boundless dark, far away in it hangs a blue and white spherical world with no wall of mist around it and stars scattered irregularly in every direction, five goddesses and the player standing at the door looking out at it

extra.zh: 标准机位全景，门在画面正中，人物是门前一排剪影；门外的世界小而清楚。
extra.en: Standard angle full shot, the door at center, the figures a row of silhouettes before it; the world outside small but clear.

items.notes: 星辰要散乱，与天穹的整齐形成对照。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 冬至审定：审庭的半圆高台上六座庭之席排开，庭镜里的大陆迎来冬至，七座天启碑同时亮起，神庭上方的白闪了一下，五位女神同时抬起头
subject.en: The winter solstice verdict: six court seats ranged on the curved dais of the court, the continent in the court mirror reaching the winter solstice with all seven steles lighting at once, the white above the court flashing once, the five goddesses lifting their heads together

extra.zh: 低机位全景，六座席在画面上方，庭镜在下方，女神们抬头看向画面顶边。
extra.en: Low full shot, the six seats along the top, the mirror below, the goddesses looking up toward the top edge.

items.notes: 附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 终战：白石审庭化作战场，地面浮起一格一格发光的几何光格，空中一圈齿轮般的几何光环缓慢转动，玩家与同伴站在光格之间，迎着正中的白光
subject.en: The final battle: the white court turned into a battlefield, the floor rising into glowing geometric grid squares, a ring of gear-like geometric halos turning slowly in the air, the player and companions standing between the squares facing the white light at the center

extra.zh: 高机位全景，光格铺满地面，光环在画面上方，人物在下方三分之一。
extra.en: High full shot, grid squares covering the floor, the halos at the top, the figures in the lower third.

items.notes: 光格与光环是神光白金；对决的对手只画成光的中心，不画清楚的人形。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 审定前夜：候见厅空荡的长椅上，发梢化作羽毛的黑发少女把一封封着暗红火漆的信递过来，她腰间的皮信囊敞开着，墙边庭镜里映着箱庭冬夜的点点灯火
subject.en: The eve of the verdict: on an empty bench in the antechamber a black-haired girl whose hair ends turn to feathers holds out a letter sealed in dark red wax, the leather satchel at her waist open, the court mirror by the wall showing the scattered lights of the world on a winter night

extra.zh: 标准机位近景，信与递信的手在画面中央，少女在左，庭镜的微光在右后。
extra.en: Standard angle close shot, the letter and the hand holding it out at center, the girl at left, the faint glow of the mirror behind at right.

items.notes: 暗红火漆是画面里唯一的暖色；信封上不画字。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。

subject.zh: 离手：候见厅的门敞开，女神们依次走进门外的光里，最后一个在门口回头，她腰间的钥匙已经不见，留在厅里的人背对画面看着她们离开
subject.en: Letting go: the antechamber door stands open, the goddesses walking one by one into the light beyond, the last one turning at the threshold with the keys gone from her waist, the ones who stay behind watching them leave with their backs to us

extra.zh: 标准机位全景，门在画面正中，门外是明亮的空白，前景是留下的人的背影。
extra.en: Standard angle full shot, the door at center opening on bright emptiness, the backs of those who remain in the foreground.

items.notes: 这是真结局的画面，光是柔和的，不是神光的白金。附上风格板与列出的人物三视图；人物是 Q 版约 1.7 头身，认得出是谁；画面里不出现任何文字（碑文、信件、书页、招牌都无字）。
